perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.desc: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Timed Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles attached to enemies explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Crossing Over
perks.desc: This weapon has increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal increased damage.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "It's no secret that I love Stasis; so naturally, this being the first on the list is exciting! RotN Judgment trades out a few perks in each column to make some notable combos. There's the self-sustaining Headstone/Rimestealer, the classic Demolitionist/Adrenaline Junkie, or Paracausal Affinity with an easy-to-proc 20% damage buff. Stats are still a little lacking compared to other 140s in this slot, especially Stability, so be sure to prioritize a little extra there." Recommended MW: Stability or Range.

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Judgment has familiar 4th column perks in Opening Shot and Timed Payload, but the 3rd column perks have joined by Keep Away and Lone Wolf. I'm especially interested in obtaining a version rocking Keep Away and Opening Shot as both provide range and accuracy through the fight. As noted for PvE rolls, while this gun did get a little stat bump on re-release, it still is lacking in Stability (and Range in PvP). Focus on one or both stats and this gun should perform decently." Recommended MW: Range or Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 141 from 27 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/51wAzrVIRJRsBHGTMCLZ0n?si=fade7bb615184d3e) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Stasis build. While adaptives lose out to double burst and precision HCs for pure damage output, Judgment offers the rare choice of sights rather than barrels, if that's your preference. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 44 Range equates to 29.94m ADS and 19.96m hipfire before damage falloff, 42 Stability is ×1.1371 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 55 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.24s ADS and 0.35s stow speed, and 45 Reload Speed is a 2.65s reload. Recoil Direction is 95, and Zoom is 14, and Magazine size is 9 (max 14). You can use any of the sight perks that don't involve a malus to fill out the stats. In the magazine perk slot, we're looking for something that helps Reload Speed. For Stasis builds, Headstone in the first trait perk column generates a stasis crystal on a crit kill, to proc fragment effects. Paracausal Affinity in the second provides a ×1.2 damage boost following a darkness energy kill, and if you shatter a Headstone crystal while active, the AoE damage inherits this boost. The Crossing Over origin trait is a little strange, providing extra range and handling in the top half of the mag, and a damage boost in the bottom starting at ×1.015 at 50% and ×1.03 with your penultimate and last shot, while Gravity Well can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with an Adept Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Stasis Shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.
